title: finance.orders.invoice.request_rejected
description: Finance refused an `operations.orders.order.invoice_requested` event (Fulfilment ADR-0024 §1/§4) — no invoice was created. `reason` is `tax_mismatch` (the recomputed subtotal, tax or total disagreed with the requester's expected_* figures — the expected/actual fields are then all present), `unknown_customer` (`customer_id` is not a `finance.customers.id` for this organization), `invalid_supply_type`, `invalid_place_of_supply`, `invalid_tax_rate` (not a statutory GST band) or `non_positive_total`. A request for an order that already has its invoice is deliberately NOT a reason here — that is a silent no-op (mirroring `commerce.invoice.finalized`'s own `nothing_to_collect` shape), nothing is published for it, and this event's absence is not evidence of anything.
